sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Evaluates risks associated with cloud infrastructure, platforms, and services. Reviews configurations, access controls, data protection, and compliance. Identifies misconfigurations and vulnerabilities in multi-cloud environments. Includes recommendations for remediation and governance. Often aligned with cloud adoption or migration phases.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Ensures secure cloud adoption and operations. Reduces risk of data leakage and service disruption. Supports compliance with cloud-specific regulations. Enhances visibility and control over cloud assets. Builds customer confidence in cloud transformation.
